verdict.rationale: Operating a government IP-office portal through natural-language commands is a fair question, since such portals could ship a chatbot or conversational assistant. The evidence describes only conventional web navigation (e-filing, status tracking, searches, forms) with no natural-language or conversational interface. The llms.txt 404 probe shows a lack of agent-oriented tooling but is not evidence of an NL command capability either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
